description: Retrieve a known artwork URL from The Met or Cleveland Museum of Art. Not artwork search. Returns source metadata and exact UTC observation time. Source statements are not legal clearance. Use manual record input for other museums.
name: still_resolve_artwork

accessDate.description: Actual date accessed YYYY-MM-DD; do not invent. Independent of source retrieval timestamps.

artist.description: Creator display name, unchanged from source.

changesAnswer.description: yes or no, only when known.

date.description: Artwork creation date, including approximate dates exactly as supplied. Not the web page date.

familyName.description: Verified family name for a personal creator; do not guess.

givenName.description: Verified given name for a personal creator; do not infer from display name.

licenceUrl.description: Source licence URL for other rights.

nameKind.description: personal for verified name parts, literal for a studio or corporate creator, unknown for unknown creator.

pageAuthor.description: Web page author, not automatically the artist.

pageDate.description: Web page publication date YYYY-MM-DD, never the artwork date.

pageFamilyName.description: Verified web page author family name.

pageGivenName.description: Verified web page author given name.

pageNameKind.description: personal, literal for an organisation, or unknown.

pageTitle.description: Museum web page title when target=museum_page.

photographer.description: Photographer or image creator stated by source.

recommendedCitation.description: Source-recommended citation retained separately from generated formats.

requiredCredit.description: Source-provided credit line. Preserved as supplied; the label does not establish a legal requirement.

rights.description: Exact image rights status from source: unknown, publicDomain, pdm, cc0, ccBy (4.0), ccBySa (4.0), or other. Use other for different versions.

sourceUrl.description: Original record page URL, not a direct image URL. This field in record is not fetched.

title.description: Artwork title as stated by the source.

title: Import a museum artwork record
